_doc: Stage 7 lane "portrait": boss portrait style fixes (painted look matching the in-game painted puppets). Two image references per job: design strip from tools/painted/raw/<boss> (the Kling sources of the in-game atlas, watermark cropped) + a style/framing strip of on-style painted portraits. Output 880x1168 on #00FF00 (behemoth #FF00FF) -> keyed (tools/higgsfield/key_green.py; magenta variant for behemoth) -> centre-cropped to 3:4 -> 768x1024 RGBA -> WebP q80 m6 alpha_quality 70 (same as the fanime install) -> lo copy by tools/assets/make_variants.py. Prompts below are condensed to the essential wording of each request (variants differed only in phrasing).

generations.prompt: Boss bust portrait for a dark-fantasy action game. Paint it in the style of the second reference image (style strip: b_dagon, b_moloch, b_colossus portraits): hand-painted digital oil painting, textured brushwork, muted desaturated colours, soft front-left key light, deep shadows; no line art, no anime, no cel shading. The character is Nightwing exactly as in the first reference image: wrinkled charcoal-grey bat face, flat pug bat nose, glowing red eyes, huge pointed ears with crimson veined membranes, gaping fanged jaws, shaggy black fur ruff, sinewy ash-grey taupe muscular torso, huge tattered dark red-brown membrane wings with black finger bones raised behind the shoulders. Framing: head, shoulders and upper chest, cut off at mid-chest by the bottom edge; head in the upper third; three-quarter view turned toward the left side. One figure only. no text, no border, no frame, plain flat solid #00FF00 green background
